m.s: Rinse {brownrice} until the water runs clear. Put it in a saucepan with twice its volume of cold water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, then cover and cook on low for 25 minutes. Take it off the heat and leave the lid on for 5 minutes.
Stir together {fishsauce}, the juice of {lime}, {brownsugar}, and finely chopped {chilli} and {garlic}. Taste: it should be hot, sour, salty and a little sweet.
Season {beef_rump} with salt. Heat a heavy frying pan over high heat until smoking. Sear for 2 to 3 minutes a side for medium-rare. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice thin across the grain.
Toss the sliced steak and its resting juices with half the dressing while it's still warm, so it soaks it up.
Tear {cos} into a big bowl. Add sliced {cucumber}, halved {cherrytom}, thinly sliced {red_onion} and the leaves from {mint} and {coriander}.
Pile the beef on the salad, pour over the rest of the dressing and finish with crushed {peanuts}. Serve the rice on the side.

l: Pack the dressing separately and toss just before eating. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: Naturally gluten free. Check the fish sauce.
